context: Treat the transaction writer and its attested receipt as the normal publication authority. Keep the legacy approved-manifest fallback during migration. After the verified publication and independent-monitor evidence exist, disable the release Pages job, retire the sync mirror writer, preserve release API-doc production and the accepted archive, and reconcile only proven set-equivalent mirror replacements. Keep branch and environment policy changes separate from artifact approval.
description: Retire release-to-Pages coupling and redundant mirror publication only after the replacement transaction writer is proven. Package release validation continues to produce packages and versioned API documentation without publishing the site, Explorer, or accepted corpus. Mirror changes are reconciled by exact path set and content digest; an older or newer PR alone is not evidence for closure. The former fixed soak and manual publication attribution inputs are superseded.

anti_patterns.dont: Close mirror PRs based on age or naming
anti_patterns.instead: prove exact set and digest replacement before closure
anti_patterns.why: a newer mirror can still omit published-only paths

anti_patterns.dont: Delete release publication wiring before corpus cutover
anti_patterns.instead: retire coupling only after all independent lanes and rollback are proven
anti_patterns.why: that creates a production update gap
